title: Core-Only Reduction After Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Appointments
content:
# Core-only reduction

A worker who has missed Functional Capacity Evaluation appointments is evaluated on a core-only basis under the Workers' Compensation Referral.

**Rule.** The core-only reduction is two (2) hours where two or more missed evaluation appointments with dates in the last month have been reported to the adjuster, one (1) hour where exactly one has, and none otherwise.

The missed appointments counted are those reported to the adjuster on the referral — late cancellations and no-shows — whose appointment dates fall in the last month.

| Missed evaluation appointments reported, dates in the last month | Core-only reduction |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 1 hour |
| 2 or more | 2 hours |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- One no-show last month, reported to the adjuster: 1 hour.
- A late cancellation and a no-show last month, both reported: 2 hours.
- A no-show two months ago, reported, and nothing since: none.
